    var datas = groups[g].data || [];
    for (var i=0; i<datas.length; i++) {
      var ent = datas[i].entity || {};
      var tr = ent.track || ent.audio || {};
      if (!tr.id) continue;
      var album = tr.album || {};
      var arts = (tr.artists || []);
      var an = []; for (var a=0; a<arts.length; a++) an.push(arts[a].name||'');
      var cov = '';
      var uc = album.url_cover || {};
      if (uc.urls && uc.urls.length) cov = uc.urls[0] + (uc.uri||'');
      out.push({
        name: tr.name || '',
        author: an.join('/'),
        coverUrl: cov,
        detail: 'https://www.qishui.com/song/' + tr.id + '?trackId=' + tr.id,
        lastChapter: '时长' + Math.round((tr.duration||0)/1000) + '秒'
      });
    }
  }
  return out;
})()</js>
